nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of the contract owner, set to msg.sender at construction and changed by transferOwnership.
BSPMintable.distributor: recipient of minted BSP tokens, changeable by owner.
BSPMintable.BSPToken: ERC20Basic token interface used for balance queries and transfers.
Constant 630000000e18 BSP reserved for mining rewards.
Constant mining duration of 4 years.
uint256[4] yearly mining rate percentages [40,20,20,20].
Flag indicating whether mining has been started.
Timestamp from which mining rewards accrue.
Accumulated amount of tokens already minted/transferred.
constructor(): sets owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership(address newOwner) onlyOwner: validates non-zero address and reassigns owner.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access restriction reused by BSPMintable.
startMining(uint256 _startTime) onlyOwner: validates token backing and timestamp window, then enables mining.
changeDistributor(address _newDistributor) onlyOwner: updates the mint recipient without validation.
mint() whenStarted: computes unminted amount, updates minted then transfers tokens to distributor.
mintableAmount() view: time-based reward computation over years/days using SafeMath and a loop.
totalBspAmount() view: contract token balance plus already minted amount.
Fallback function: always reverts to reject plain Ether transfers.
SafeMath.mul: overflow-checked multiplication.
SafeMath.div: plain division.
SafeMath.sub: assert-guarded subtraction.
SafeMath.add: assert-guarded addition.
SafeERC20.safeTransfer: asserts the result of ERC20Basic.transfer.
External ERC20 transfer invoked through the token interface.
External ERC20 balanceOf queried through the token interface.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment and onlyOwner authorization.
Miner-influenced current time used for the mining schedule and start-time validation.
External token transfer BSPToken.safeTransfer(distributor, unminted) executed inside mint().
External token balance query BSPToken.balanceOf(this) used for backing checks and reward math.
Composite reward arithmetic rewardAmount.mul(rate).div(100/36500).mul(day) accumulated in a loop.
newOwner parameter of transferOwnership.
_startTime parameter of startMining.
_newDistributor parameter of changeDistributor.
unminted local holding mintableAmount() result in mint().
currentYear local derived from elapsed time in mintableAmount().
currentDay local derived from elapsed time in mintableAmount().
currentMintable accumulator local in mintableAmount().
Loop index i over the mining rate array in mintableAmount().

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to owner, establishing privileged access.
owner is derived from untrusted msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
newOwner parameter flows into the ownership reassignment.
transferOwnership writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares untrusted msg.sender against owner.
Authorization decision reads the owner state variable.
startMining is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
changeDistributor is restricted to the owner via onlyOwner.
_startTime parameter drives the start time assignment.
startMining validates _startTime against block.timestamp (timestamp dependency).
startMining writes the startTime state variable.
startMining writes the started state variable.
startMining performs an external BSPToken.balanceOf call.
startMining reads the BSPToken interface state variable.
startMining checks the balance against the rewardAmount constant.
startMining uses SafeMath.add for block.timestamp + 60 days.
changeDistributor writes the distributor state variable.
mint() calls mintableAmount() to compute the reward.
whenStarted modifier compares startTime with untrusted block.timestamp.
mint() reads startTime through the whenStarted modifier.
mint() requires started == true.
mintableAmount() result is stored in the unminted local.
mint() increments the minted state variable.
mint() performs an external token transfer to the distributor, the only external call that moves value.
mint() reads the distributor state variable as transfer recipient.
mint() acts on the BSPToken interface state variable.
mint() uses SafeMath.add to update minted.
mintableAmount() derives year/day counters from untrusted block.timestamp.
mintableAmount() reads startTime to compute elapsed time.
mintableAmount() reads the started flag to short-circuit.
mintableAmount() subtracts already minted tokens.
mintableAmount() uses the rewardAmount constant in reward math.
mintableAmount() reads the miningRate array.
mintableAmount() uses the duration constant.
currentYear local computed from elapsed time.
currentDay local computed from elapsed time.
currentMintable accumulator holds the computed reward.
Loop index i iterates over the mining rate array.
mintableAmount() performs mixed multiplication/division reward arithmetic.
Reward arithmetic uses SafeMath.mul.
Reward arithmetic uses SafeMath.div.
Reward arithmetic accumulates with SafeMath.add.
Reward arithmetic subtracts minted with SafeMath.sub.
totalBspAmount() reads the BSPToken interface state variable.
totalBspAmount() performs an external BSPToken.balanceOf call.
totalBspAmount() adds the minted state variable.
The external transfer call is routed through SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
safeTransfer invokes the external ERC20Basic.transfer callback.

normalization_plan.reason: The newOwner parameter has no independent security meaning outside transferOwnership and merges into that function.
_startTime only affects startMining's timestamp validation and startTime assignment.
_newDistributor is only consumed by changeDistributor when writing the distributor state variable.
unminted is a temporary holding the mintableAmount() result before the minted update and transfer.
currentYear is intermediate time indexing used only inside the reward computation.
currentDay is intermediate time indexing used only inside the reward computation.
currentMintable is the accumulator of the reward arithmetic operation and merges into it.
Loop index i is a loop control detail of the yearly rate summation.
